faqWithdraw: How do I withdraw my earnings?
faqWithdrawAnswer: Go to the Wallet page and click 'Request Payout' once you reach the minimum balance.
faqAffiliateLinks: How do I generate affiliate links?
faqAffiliateLinksAnswer: Visit the Product Market, choose a product, and click 'Get My Link'.
stillNeedHelp: Still need help? Contact us using the form.
faqWhenPayout: When will my payout be processed?
faqWhenPayoutAnswer: Most payouts are processed within 2–5 business days after request approval.
faqPayoutMethodAnswer: Currently, we support only IBAN (Turkish bank accounts). More methods coming soon!
faqContactChange: How can I change my registered email or phone?
faqContactChangeAnswer: Go to Settings to update your contact information. For further help, contact support.
faqWithdrawAnswerLong: Go to the Wallet page and click 'Request Payout' after reaching the minimum balance. If your IBAN or bank info is missing or invalid, you won’t be able to make a request. For detailed payout rules and minimum limits, see the Wallet page FAQ.
faqAffiliateLinksAnswerLong: Visit the Product Market, select any product, and click 'Get My Link'. Your unique affiliate link will appear instantly. You can share this link anywhere. If you remove a product, your link will remain valid until the expiry date or product deactivation.
faqWhenPayoutAnswerLong: Most payouts are processed within 2–5 business days after admin approval. Delays can occur during weekends, holidays, or if your bank details need manual review.
faqPayoutMethodAnswerLong: Currently, only IBAN (Turkish bank accounts) are supported for payouts. If you have a non-Turkish bank, please contact support to request alternative methods. More payout options are coming soon.
faqContactChangeAnswerLong: You can update your email, name, or phone number from the Settings page. If you’re unable to change your contact info due to an error, contact support and we’ll help you update your details securely.
faqNoCommission: I don't see any commission or earnings for my link?
faqNoCommissionAnswerLong: If a product is deactivated or you have reached your commission quota, you will no longer earn for new sales on that link. Check the Product Market for available active campaigns.
